# Arya Vaidya Vilasini Vaidya Sala (AVVVS)

> AVVVS is an Ayurveda institution in Kozhikode, Kerala, India, founded in 1921 by Kaloor Neelakandan Vaidyar. It makes more than 300 classical and proprietary Ayurveda formulations in its own GMP-certified factory and works with partner brands, hotels, resorts and spas.

Key facts:
- Founded: 1921, Kozhikode (Calicut), Kerala, India, as a pharmacy preparing and dispensing Ayurveda medicines, with the blessings and advice of Sree Narayana Guru.
- Family: founder Kaloor Neelakandan Vaidyar (1895–1967); his son K. N. Ramadas Vaidyar (1934–1998); today Managing Director Dr Manoj Kaloor (son of K. N. Ramadas Vaidyar, third generation) with Dr Reeja Manoj, and a fourth generation of the family in the work. Four generations in all.
- Products: more than 300 classical and proprietary formulations, among them Mezhu Thailam, Rujanth, Slepan, Red Irons and Lakshol.
- Factory: GMP-certified, in Kozhikode; capsule, blister, ointment and cosmetic lines alongside traditional mechanised units; stringent quality control measures.
- Markets: throughout India; exported to the United States, Russia, Austria, Slovenia, Colombia and other countries.
- Ways to work with AVVVS: AVVVS Manufacturing Division (own products, third-party and white-label manufacturing); AVVVS Ayur Specialty Clinic (https://clinic.avvvs.com/; in-clinic and online consultations, treatment programmes); Ayur Store, the AVVVS online shop (https://shop.avvvs.com/); Gloveda Herbals (skin and hair care, https://glovedaherbals.com/); Gloveda Experience (luxury Ayur-Medi cosmetic clinics as standalone destinations and in five-star properties and Ayurvedic resorts); Gloveda Revive (Ayur-Medi cosmetic clinics, standalone or within Ayurvedic hospitals and treatment centres).
- Contact: mail@avvvs.com · +91 80892 02091 · +91 80892 02092 · Arya Vaidya Vilasini Vaidya Sala Corporate Office, Kaloor Central, Annie Hall Road, Chalappuram PO, Kozhikode 673002, Kerala, India.
